items.title: 13.10.1 Reaction with cold aqueous sodium hydroxide (thande NaOH ke saath reaction) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.10.1, printed page 300.

blocks.text: Chlorine jab thande aqueous sodium hydroxide (NaOH) se react karti hai to disproportion hoti hai aur sodium chloride (NaCl) aur sodium chlorate (I) (NaClO) banati hai.
Is reaction mein chlorine ki oxidation states (oxidation number) yeh hain:

blocks.title: Keep in Mind! (yaad rakhein)
blocks.text: Sodium chlorate (I) ko pehle sodium hypochlorite kaha jata tha.
Cl₂ ki chlorine NaOCl (yani NaClO) mein 0 se +1 tak oxidize hoti hai, aur NaCl mein 0 se -1 tak reduce hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke NaCl mein chlorine “0 se 1” tak reduce hoti hai. Minus ka nishan chhoot gaya hai: NaCl mein chlorine -1 hai, is liye sahi “0 se -1” hai. Reduction mein oxidation number ghat-ta hai, barhta nahi.
Is reaction mein chlorine ek hi waqt mein oxidize bhi hoti hai aur reduce bhi; yeh disproportionation reaction ki misal hai.

items: Thanda NaOH: Cl₂ + 2NaOH → NaCl + NaClO + H₂O.
Cl: 0 se -1 (reduce) aur 0 se +1 (oxidize); NaClO = sodium chlorate (I) = sodium hypochlorite.
